description: Check a marketing or bulk email's one-click unsubscribe headers against RFC 8058 before sending (large mailbox providers ask bulk senders for one-click unsubscribe). Send the List-Unsubscribe header value, the List-Unsubscribe-Post header value and, if you have it, the DKIM-Signature header value. Get back whether the message is one-click ready: the HTTPS address found (its host only), each other address (mailto and so on), whether the Post header is exactly the one key/value pair, whether the DKIM h= list covers both headers, and each problem by its RFC rule. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/one-click-unsubscribe-check). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

dkim_signature.description: Optional: the DKIM-Signature header value (v=1; a=...; d=...; h=...; ...). Only its h= tag is read.

list_unsubscribe.description: The List-Unsubscribe header value as sent (without the 'List-Unsubscribe:' name), e.g. <https://example.com/unsub/opaque>, <mailto:unsub@example.com>. Folded lines are fine.

list_unsubscribe_post.description: The List-Unsubscribe-Post header value (without its name). Leave out if the message has none.

name: one_click_unsubscribe_check
title: One-Click Unsubscribe Header Check
